watchOS 27.2 will be released next month, bringing multiple new Apple Watch features, and leaker pdfu has just discovered major changes to the screenshot function.

watchOS 27.2 introduces a redesigned screenshot experience inspired by iPhone

Leaker pdfu has recently been sharing various details discovered from Apple's code. He previously uncovered the “Readiness” app in watchOS 27, and yesterday leaked the interface design for Siri AI on HomePod.

pdfu revealed in a new post today that the watchOS 27.2 beta includes code related to the redesigned screenshot experience for Apple Watch.

Currently, taking a screenshot on Apple Watch just causes the screen to flash, then the screenshot is saved to your Photos library.

The new screenshot flow mimics the existing operation on iPhone and iPad, allowing you to instantly choose to share or delete the screenshot.

It is currently unknown whether Apple plans to include this change in the upcoming watchOS 27.2 beta, or whether it needs more development time. However, even if watchOS 27.2 ultimately misses the cut, we still have a high chance of seeing this feature on Apple Watch in the near future.

What do you think of the new screenshot experience revealed for watchOS 27.2? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
